title: AICTE Regulation-as-Code Rule Schema
description: Validation schema for declarative AICTE Approval Process Handbook regulatory rules

id.description: Unique identifier for the regulatory rule (e.g. RULE_FIRE_NOC_VALIDITY)

version.description: Semantic version of the rule specification (e.g. 1.0.0)

clause_ref.description: Official Approval Process Handbook clause citation (e.g. APH-2025-Cl-4.1.1)

title.description: Human-readable concise title of the regulatory rule

applies_to.description: List of application categories to which this rule applies (e.g. Extension of Approval (EoA), Increase in Intake)

type.description: Classification category governing the rule evaluation algorithm

parameters.description: Key-value dictionary containing rule-specific regulatory threshold values and field bindings

severity.description: Regulatory severity level when a non-compliance condition is detected

message_template.description: Python string template for rendering the explainable finding explanation

remediation_hint.description: Actionable instructions provided to the institution/scrutiny officer for resolving the shortfall

effective_from.description: Statutory effective commencement date in YYYY-MM-DD format

category.description: Optional governance classification (e.g. Faculty, Safety, Infrastructure, Land)

description.description: Detailed statutory background and legal basis from the handbook
